email_subject: Application - Founding Creator and Social Media Associate
email_body:
Dear LINEAL Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Founding Creator and Social Media Associate role. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and social media, I'm excited about the opportunity to capture LINEAL's journey and tell stories that make people want to follow along.

At Episto, I've been producing keyword-targeted content and managing social media integration for client sites, while my own project mirook.com has given me full creative control—from designing the site to implementing structured data and growing its social presence. I'm comfortable with video editing, content planning, and working independently, and I'm eager to bring that creator mindset to courtside and backstage settings.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and available for onsite events and travel. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving.

I'd love to discuss how I can help grow LINEAL's channels and create content that resonates. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear LINEAL Team,

When I read that you're looking for a Founding Creator and Social Media Associate, I felt a jolt of recognition. This isn't a job posting for another corporate social media manager—it's a call for someone who lives and breathes storytelling, who gets excited about capturing raw moments and turning them into narratives that people can't stop watching. That's exactly the kind of work I've been doing, and I'd love to bring that energy to LINEAL.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I've learned the mechanics of content: how to research keywords, write compelling blog posts, and optimize them for search engines. But my true passion lies in the creative side—building mirook.com from scratch, designing its look, writing its content, and integrating social media to tell the story of a young chess champion. I've filmed and edited short videos for social, planned content calendars, and experimented with formats to see what resonates. I'm not just a poster; I'm a producer.

What draws me to LINEAL is the chance to be where the action is—courtside, backstage, on the road. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, just outside Antwerp, so I can easily attend events and shoots. I'm comfortable with the flexibility required, including Friday evening events and occasional travel. I'm also fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving, which could help connect with a diverse audience.

I'm eager to bring my technical skills—SEO, analytics, and content management—to complement my creative instincts. I want to help LINEAL not just grow its following, but build a community that feels invested in every fight, every athlete, and every behind-the-scenes moment.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd love to talk about how I can contribute to LINEAL's story.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
